pendingResolved2026_07_25: Section I part minutes: re-fetched https://apcentral.collegeboard.org/courses/ap-japanese-language-and-culture/exam on 2026-07-25. College Board prints no per-question DURATION for the project speaking tasks. What it prints is prose already carried verbatim in each part's toolNote — "(3 minutes to prepare; 3 minutes to present.)" for Question 1 and "(40 seconds for each response.)" for Question 2, and "Students have 30 minutes to complete both writing tasks (Questions 3 and 4)" for Questions 3-4 (a combined figure carried in each row's note). Summing 3+3, or 4x40 seconds, or splitting a combined figure would be the back-computation the data rule forbids, so "pending" -> null (College Board publishes no per-part length).
